title: Redis Hot Account Rebuild
description: Rebuild Redis hot-account balances from MySQL (only accounts with enabled=1 in hot_account_config). Typical scenarios: Redis data loss / corruption / suspected dirty writes. It is recommended to run a dry-run first to inspect the diff before executing for real.

form.asOfModeNow: Current MySQL balance (most common, recovery after Redis restart)
form.asOfModeDuration: Roll back N minutes ago (suspecting recent writes are bad)
form.asOfModeTimestamp: Roll back to a specific timestamp
form.accountNosTooltip: Empty = rebuild all enabled hot accounts. Separate multiple accounts with commas or newlines. Accounts must still exist in hot_account_config.
form.dryRunLabel: Dry run (only compute diff, do not write Redis)
